title: Agent design patterns and trade-offs
subtitle: Use patterns to solve concrete coordination and reasoning problems.
goal: Recognize patterns by the problem they solve
intro: Agent patterns describe who decides, who acts, and how results are checked; they are not badges of architectural maturity.
terms: Checks a result against a rubric
case: Compare an exact request lookup with an open-ended support investigation.
Different tasks justify different control structures.
More agents can add coordination failures without adding useful expertise.
